behaviors.title: Follow an author and update the feed
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, sign in with email "carol@example.com" and password "conduit-demo", open alice's profile, follow alice, open Home and select "Your Feed", collect all visible article titles in display order and store the visible article titles in display order as 'article_titles', then verify the stored article_titles value is "Favorites and counters, Pagination without surprises, Markdown in article bodies, A tour of the RealWorld spec, Testing in plain English, How to retire an AngularJS app"; open alice's profile, unfollow alice, open Home and select "Your Feed", collect all visible article titles in display order and store the visible article titles in display order as 'article_titles', then verify the stored article_titles value is "none" and the page shows "No articles are here... yet.".

behaviors.title: Browse profile article tabs
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, open bob's profile, collect the visible My Articles titles in display order and store the visible My Articles titles in display order as 'article_titles', then verify the stored article_titles value is "Designing a follow feed, Boring databases win"; select "Favorited Articles", collect the visible article titles in display order and store the visible article titles in display order as 'favorite_article_titles', then verify the stored favorite_article_titles value is "Favorites and counters"; navigate directly to carol's profile, select "My Articles", collect the visible article titles in display order and store the visible article titles in display order as 'article_titles', then verify the stored article_titles value is "none" and the page shows "No articles are here... yet.".

behaviors.title: Post and remove a comment
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, sign in with email "alice@example.com" and password "conduit-demo", open "Boring databases win", enter "A useful reminder." in the comment box and post it, collect the visible comment texts in newest-first display order and store the visible comment texts in newest-first display order as 'comment_texts', then verify the stored comment_texts value is "A useful reminder., Agreed, boring is a feature."; delete "A useful reminder.", collect the visible comment texts in newest-first display order and store the visible comment texts in newest-first display order as 'comment_texts', then verify the stored comment_texts value is "Agreed, boring is a feature.".

behaviors.title: Publish a tagged article
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, sign in with email "carol@example.com" and password "conduit-demo", open New Article, enter title "A new field note", description "A short report from the field.", and body "First line.", add tags "testing", "notes", and "draft", remove "draft", publish the article, collect the visible tag labels in display order and store the visible tag labels in display order as 'article_tags', then verify the page shows "A new field note" and "First line." and the stored article_tags value is "testing, notes"; open carol's profile, select "My Articles", collect the visible My Articles titles in display order and store the visible My Articles titles in display order as 'article_titles', then verify the stored article_titles value is "A new field note".

behaviors.title: Edit an existing article
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, sign in with email "alice@example.com" and password "conduit-demo", open "Testing in plain English", choose "Edit Article", replace the description with "Behavior specifications for every team." and the body with "Updated **bold** guidance.", publish the changes, collect the visible description text and store the visible description text as 'article_description', then verify the stored article_description value is "Behavior specifications for every team." and the body shows "Updated" and bold text "bold"; open "Testing in plain English", collect the visible description text and store the visible description text as 'article_description', then verify the stored article_description value is "Behavior specifications for every team.".

behaviors.title: Redirect signed-out visitors from protected pages
behaviors.objective: Starting from the seeded app, sign in with email "alice@example.com" and password "conduit-demo", open New Article and verify the article editor is shown; open Settings and verify "Your Settings" is shown; sign out, open Home, collect the visible feed tab labels in display order and store the visible feed tab labels in display order as 'feed_tabs', then verify the stored feed_tabs value is "Global Feed" and the navigation shows "Sign in" and "Sign up".
